source: Virtual Analog Buchla 259 Wavefolder (Esqueda, Pöntynen, Välimäki, Parker, DAFx-17, 2017)
note: Images embedded in the PDF, one file per image, named p<page>-<n>.webp. 'captions_on_page' lists short title-like lines found on the same page; they are candidates, not matched to a specific image. Private reference material: same rules as library text. Entries marked whole_page are the whole page rendered as a picture, because its figures are drawn as lines and are not embedded pictures.
